reviews.title: Trans Nusa is Indonesia’s worst airline.
reviews.text: Avoid this airline, they did gave me announcement of delay 1 day prior, flight was supposed to depart at 18:00 but rescheduled until 23:00. Fine, we were able to find half day accommodation in Bali, after checking in at 20:30 we found out further delay until god knows when as it is 00:37AM now and we are still waiting to board. What a waste of time, we have an early appointment tomorrow morning in Jakarta, looks like we won’t be sleeping tonight 🙄
reviews.author: Nat Tink

reviews.title: First time used and will do again
reviews.text: Smooth booking, easy and fast check in, flight was on time, friendly staff on the flight, good service when I ordered something. Luggage arrived as fast as we did. I cannot say anything bad about this airline.
reviews.author: Manu H

reviews.title: Avoid the airline at all costs.
reviews.text: I took a flight with transnusa. It got delayed from 5 to 6 to 9 to 10 to 11:10. Absolutely atrocious. The personnel was massively unfriendly, and was looking at their phones while saying to each other "you take the customer" - "nah, you take him; I'm bored". The airline is unreliable and not worth the cheap prices. Avoid it or you might have a 8 hour wait in Jakarta like me.
reviews.author: Philipp T

reviews.title: Worst Airline
reviews.text: My flight from Jakarta to Denpasar was delayed for 3 hours. As a result, I can’t catch up with my flight to Australia. I contacted the customer services but they’re so helpless. Avoid this airline at all costs
reviews.author: Axel G

reviews.title: the winner of the flight delay
reviews.text: if your schedule is very tight, think again about using this plane, because almost all flights every day are not on time, even ground officers can't answer when asked what time the plane will come and be flown back
reviews.author: Ada_Iant

reviews.title: Good service, on schedule flight.
reviews.text: Booked an early flight from UPG to KOE with 20 minutes stopover at MOF. The boarding time was on time, and I arrived on schedule. Check-in process was a bit slow as they only had 2 counters opened. They gave mineral water in a plastic glass and 1 piece of bread, which was already better service than its competition in budget airline class. The legroom was also quite more humane than the flying lion, to my surprise. Overall I'm quite pleased flying with TransNusa.
reviews.author: J Aditya T

reviews.title: Friendly staff regional carrier
reviews.text: Leaves on time no nonsense friendly carrier that always pleasant to travel on! Very scenic trip from Larantuka always a pleasure to experience!
reviews.author: Alexander M

reviews.title: Another Option
reviews.text: In many small towns in Indonesia, there are only limited airlines to fly in or out of the town. From Bajawa to Kupang there are only two airlines. This was first time we tried TransNusa, and on our flight to Kupang it provided pretty good service, passengers served with one soft bread and a glass of mineral water. The best thing was that it landed so smoothly in Kupang. We would prefer to pick this airline again when flying to Bajawa.
reviews.author: TheNatNat
